description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableSource class in a Java project. It tests JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, and specific properties of the ImmutableSource class related to connectivity sources like AMQP and MQTT. The file includes test data initialization, static constants, and several test methods verifying the behavior and correctness of the ImmutableSource class.

classes.name: ImmutableSourceTest
classes.description: A unit test class for ImmutableSource covering equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and property modification tests.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for ImmutableSource.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableSource is immutable, particularly collections and fields.

methods.description: Tests that converting an ImmutableSource instance to JSON produces the expected output.
